name: Nexus
notes: Backup Setup now uses a native Android PC Backup Bridge for health checks and backup copy before falling back to WebView fetch.
Nexus release packaging now defaults to the free GitHub raw manifest and GitHub Releases APK path.
Update Center now shows feed behind when the installed app is newer than the public release feed.
Release package verification now checks that the local manifest and APK target the GitHub feed correctly.
Odin Tool Belt now shows the exact active tool chain used by the engine.
Engine Room now separates ready tools from gated, missing, and planned tools.
Odin autonomous receipts now record the full tool chain and missing tool count.
Odin gained Release Verifier, Chat Memory, Heimdall Gate, Model Router, and planned Sandbox Runner tool entries.
Engine action buttons are clearer on mobile so Strengthen Odin and Scan Odin stay visible.
Odin Engine now has a truthful tool belt with ready, gated, and planned tools.
Odin now selects one tool for each repair cycle and shows the tool plan in Engine Room.
Autonomous Odin receipts now record which tool lane was used or gated.
Engine Room now shows ready, gated, and planned tool counts without claiming unavailable tools are active.
Odin Engine now shows mission, objective, neural charge, confidence, autonomy readiness, and proof state.
Odin now explains what the next autonomous repair cycle will do before it runs.
Engine Room now has an intelligence panel that makes Odin's power easier to understand.
Odin now runs an autonomous local maintenance loop every 10 minutes while Nexus is open.
Odin autonomous maintenance scans, repairs, hardens, and writes receipts without a manual button press.
Engine Room now shows auto-maintenance status, last run, next run, cycle count, and the latest repair result.
Odin Engine now has a Live Cycle readout showing current thought, action, repair, and proof in plain language.
Engine Room now has direct Strengthen Odin and Scan Odin actions so Odin can visibly work and write local receipts.
Odin alive readout now explains what the engine is thinking and acting on before the next hardening cycle.
Odin Engine now explains itself in plain language: what it is doing, what power means, what is weak, and what to do next.
Engine Room now has an Odin readout that turns live engine metrics into understandable status lines.
Odin now produces alive readout lines from its current power, weak point, and next hardening action.
Odin Engine now shows a reactor-style power core with visible output, focus, repair, and growth strength.
Odin Core now calculates power output, focus intensity, repair velocity, and growth pressure from live engine state.
Engine Room now makes Odin feel more alive with power rings, reactor rays, and a compact power matrix.
Nexus now has a native Android updater bridge that downloads the APK inside Nexus and opens the install prompt directly.
Update Nexus now falls back to browser download only when the native updater is unavailable.
Nexus requests Android package install permission for private APK updates.
Odin Engine now has a visible cognitive core for perception, working memory, reasoning, tool use, verification, and self repair.
Engine Room now shows Odin thought loop, memory cells, and foundation readiness.
Odin hardening now treats this engine as the foundation template for future engines.
Download button is hidden when Nexus is already up to date.
Last checked status is shown in a compact row.
Release feed is prepared for stable static hosting.
Built-in Nexus feed now points at the stable Netlify release feed.
APK download now uses the stable Netlify release host.
Drag-deploy headers are bundled with the release feed.
Transient feed refresh failures no longer overwrite an already current status.
Nexus Engine Kernel added for local health, scan, approval, and intake receipts.
Engine Room command page added.
Per-character domain engines now track strength, memory, protection, learning, scans, and next actions.
Harden Engines command added to strengthen every character engine through a supervised local cycle.
Nexus supervisor now reports average strength, guarded engines, stale engines, and the next directive.
Odin is the only installed engine while other character engines remain dormant behind Heimdall.
The Architect maintainer now hardens, repairs, upgrades, and records growth cycles for installed engines.
Engine Room now groups receipts by Odin and The Architect.
Odin Brain now has a stronger OpenRouter system prompt with Nexus safety gates.
Command Center now shows whether Odin Brain has an encrypted provider key stored.
Odin chat now shows provider, memory, and Heimdall gate status before AI unlock.
Nexus now shows an in-app update banner when the stable feed has a newer build.
Update Center wording now makes clear that phone-side manifest paste and PowerShell are not part of the app update flow.
Update controls now use the direct Update Nexus action.
Release automation contract added so a trusted publisher can send builds to the stable feed.
Odin Engine Core now tracks the full engine formula as nine measurable lanes.
Odin hardening cycles now strengthen core lanes and report the weakest lane.
Engine Room now shows Odin maturity, provider state, formula lanes, and next upgrade directive.
Odin Engine Room now has a visible live core with orbit, heartbeat, active lane pulses, and run-stage readout.
Run Engine now shows a local visible cycle before writing the hardening receipt.
Odin Engine Core now has life-sign metrics for pulse, breath, synapse, coherence, and adaptation.
Engine Room now renders a breathing neural field, signal stream, drifting nodes, and richer live core motion.
Odin focused hardening now strengthens the living core and records pulse in the hardening receipt.
Mobile command center is condensed to reduce scrolling while keeping high-value status visible.
Odin Engine now exposes nervous-system load, reflex state, active processes, and learning loop.
Engine Room now shows compact living vitals and fewer signal rows on mobile.
Focused hardening cycles now push Odin harder through stronger repair and maintenance gains.
Odin Engine now has a visible organism layer with Heart, Breath, Mind, Spine, and Shield systems.
Engine Room now condenses nervous system, learning loop, autonomic loop, and repair queue into one stronger live panel.
Focused hardening receipts now record Odin living state alongside core score, pulse, nervous load, and weakest lane.
